title: Save errors, delete success and lookup source now say Part Library
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the build under test with access to the Part Library and a work order.
custom_steps:
1. Trigger a save failure on a library entry and read the message.
  2. Delete a library entry and read the success message.
  3. On a work order part lookup, read the source label of a result that comes from the shared list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The save-failure message reads "Failed to save library part." (was "...catalog part."); the delete-success message reads "Library part deleted successfully." (was "Catalog part...").
  • A part lookup result from the shared list shows its source as "Part Library" (was "Catalog").

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 12 (Rename Catalog to Part Library); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R4: “The failure message when saving a library entry reads Failed to save library part. It read Failed to save catalog part.”
  • S12-R5: “The success message when deleting a library entry reads Library part deleted successfully. It read Catalog part deleted successfully.”
  • S12-R10: “A part lookup result that comes from the shared list shows its source as Part Library. It showed Catalog.”
